title: Alternatives
description: Giving some much needed uses to the under-used elements of the game.
body:
Alternatives is a Vanilla+ mod with a few goals, revamping some under-used items, giving alternate uses for existing items, adding some features that should've always existed, and plenty more to come!

Here's a full list of what's new!
- Ink Wells replace the ink sac when making Book & Quills. Has a durability of 4, allowing for more books to be made without having to farm ink.
- Each goat horn now has applies a unique effect to all players in a 16 block area, some helpful, and some not-so-helpful.
- Poisonus Potatos can now be composted! They also can be used in place of spider eyes to make Potions of Poison.
- Cauldrons can now remove the color from more blocks! Those being wool, carpet, terracota (not glazed), banners, and candles.
